comments.text: Mayumi is my favorite character from my favorite Touhou Videogame. She is one of the most ignored parts of the game. This is due to her character not being explored in any way nor having the same depth as the rest of the cast. You could say that I like the Mayumi in my head more than the actual character, and you would be right. But a character who has bought me such creative joys is one that I will always appreciate, such is the nature of the Touhou Project.
